adminInfo.note: According to a post-colophon verse, it took about 40 days to put the text into writing. A post-colophon addition provides a lineage, in which the last legible name is 'Bre shes rab 'bar (ID:3807), followed by some more names.

person.note:
See [BAQ9MH4T]: 193 for the main events of his life.
Three manuscript editions of his writings and translations were deposited respectively in rNgog Blo ldan shes rab's tomb, in the monastery of gSang phu (probably in the main assembly hall), and in Drin las kyi sde (ID:4357) ([7FZ3B926]: 107).

Further holy places associated to him are: Ze thang, Grwa thang and rMog po ([647FFPZR]: 545, based on [Q3KCZX7B]: 38). Remembered for thirteen distinguished objects (such as royal insignia and religious articles), which could be objects of his clan ([4LDAV8UH]: 95.).

The last trace of his existence is in 1144 when he took over the head of rgyal lha khang.").

dGe 'dun grub pa (ID:7060) is renowned as his reincarnation and his 'Brom ston-like qualities are described ([BKUHJCNA]: 787-790).

person.note: Fl. late 12th to early 13th c. [MPRU5QUC] records the name of this abbot as "'Jam dpal seng ge." He received the name "'jam pa'i rdo rje" during a tantric initiation ([5632TFMN]: 312 and n. 11). [AT6DUUJJ]: 23 discusses his dates, suggesting he lived towards the end of the 12th century.. [5632TFMN]: 313 suggests he may have passed away in ca. 1227.

Likely the same person as Zhang ye ba smon lam tshul khrims (ID:5972).

His origin has been tentatively assumed to be Indic, on the basis of his name likely being a Tibetan transliteration of abhayā. A certain Jo bo a b+ha ya kA ra is mentioned as a compiler of the text in the colophon to the rDo rje nag po chen po'i mngon spyod kyi sbyin sreg (P 4954).

bibl.author: khu ston shes rab brtson 'grus
bibl.note:
Commentary on Haribhadra’s Abhisamayālaṃkāravṛtti (ID:3711), with references to an anonymous “Spiritual teacher,” to Jo bo 'bum pa (ID:5611), as well as to Atiśa (ID:3745), 'Brom (ID:3827), Zangs kar (ID:3944), Khyung po (ID:4294), an unidentified "mda'" (ID:4303) and "jo bo a sya/pya" (ID:6944), and about 50 times to "lo tsha ba," i.e. rNgog Blo ldan shes rab (ID:3786). The author claims to have followed the teaching of his Spiritual teachers in composing the work on request of his disciples and students.
This work probably corresponds to one of the three commentaries on the Abhisamayālaṃkāra (ID:3706) by Khu Shes rab brtson 'grus listed in the Tho yig, see (ID:6532), (ID:6533), (ID:6534).

yan lag gi rten la shes rab ni jo bo 'buM
pa ni dbu ma sgyu ma lta bu dang | rab du mi gnas pa gnyis kyi don shes pa ste | dang po ni snang la bden pa'i chos kyis stong ba yin la | gnyis pa ni snang ba tsaM du yang mi gnas pa yin no ||
des na shes rab ni don ma shes pa × don dam pa'i rab du mi gnas pa dang | sgyu ma lta bu ni 'o zhes 'chad pa ni jo bo'i dgongs pa ma yin no || °°°°°° dbu ma nyid °°°°°°

lo tsha ba ltar na khyod bshad par dam bcas nas bstan chos 'chad na | bstan chos kyi brjod bya mngon par rtogs pa thams cad nyams su myong nas saM | 'on te bla ma daM pa'i bdaMgdams ngag la brten nas 'chad |
lo tsha ba ltar na tshig rkang pa gnyis po des rang don dang gzhan don gyi yon tan ston la | dang po ni snga ma dang 'dra'o || gnyis pa la gzhan don gyi rgyu bsam pa dang | ngo bo sbyor ba'o ||

'di la lo tsha ba ni mkhyen pa gsuM dus gsuM dang 'brel pa | rang dang gzhan thams cad kyi thun mong ba | 'phags pa'i gang zag thams cad kyi rgyud la skye ba | shes bya rgya mtsho lta bu spyi yin la | sbyor ba bzhi dang chos sku × ni sbyor ba nyaMs su len pa po bdag nyid dang 'brel pa'i rgyu dang 'bras bu'i bye brag min pas | de'i skra'i rtse mo chu'i tshod tsaM
yin pas de rgya mtsho lta bu der ji ste mi 'du | des na mkhyen pa gsuM la bstod pas brgyad ka la bstod par 'grub po | de'i phyir grangs nyung ba'i skyon med do zhes zer ro ||

lo tsha bas ye shes kyi bdag nyid mkhyen pa gsuM chos sku las
gzugs kyi sku'i sangs rgyas skyes pas yuM sras su gsungs pa ni mi rigs ste | sa dang po nyid du yon tan gyi che ba dang mtshan dang zhing dag pa dang | sprul pa brgya' 'gyed pa'i sku gsuM po cig ma thob nas | sa gnyis pa la yon tan dag pa dang mtshan dang zhing dag pa lhag pa dang | sprul pa stong 'gyed pa la sogs pas de nyid sbyong ba yin no | |
lo tsha ba ni tshul ni rang bzhin yin pas | rang bzhin tha dad pa gsuM pa can zhes 'chad de 'og du bshad par bya'o | |

khyung po dang mda' na re sa bcu pa'i dkyil stod la yod pa yin te | de byang ghub seMs dpa'i mngon rtogs yin pas so || des na sa bcu pa'i stod la rnaM kun | dkyil la rtse mo || smad la mthar gyis pa | tha ma la skad cig ma zer ro || de dag gis 'di snyaM du spyir rtse mo brtan par byed pa mthar gyis pa yin no zhes bshad pas | de sa bcu rgyun gyi tha ma la byas na mthar gyis pa'i
bstan byar mi 'thad de | de la rim pa med pa dang | de'i gong na laM gzhan med pa'i phyir ro zhes bsaMs pa yin no || de rnaMs ni mi rigs ste |

°°°°°° zhes pa la | mda' dang khyung po na re | sa bcu'i yin te | sa dang po thob ma thag la sbyin pa dang ldan pa | de bogs sbung pa khyad par can la mngon par shes pa dang ldan pa la sogs pa yin
no || de bzhin du sa bcu pa'i bar du sbyar ro zhes zer ro || de ni seng ge bzang po'i 'dod pa ma yin te | des don gyi go rims su bshad pas de lta na go rims 'khrugs par 'gyur bas so ||

gnyis pa la
lo tsha ba na re dmigs pa dang rnaM pa mi brda' pa 'di dag kyang rjes thob kyis bsdus pa yin par 'thad de | mnyaM par bzhag pa'i tshe ni thams cad du chos kyi dbyings kyi rnaM
pa can nyid do || 'on kyang rjes kyis mtshon nas 'di ltar bshad par zad do zhes zer ro ||
lha rje na re chos kyi °°° dbyings kyi che ba dang | thabs la mkhas pa'i che ba gnyis kyi dbang du byas nas yin te | dang po'i dbang du byas nas nges 'byed thams cad kyang dmigs pa mi rtag pa la sogs pa la rnaM pa °°° mngon par zhen pa la sogs pa bkag pa'i chos nyid kyis dmigs par byed pas yin pas dmigs rnaM la khyad med do ||
gnyis pa'i dbang du byas nas sems can mos pa sna tshogs pa rnaMs kyi mos pa dang bstun nas de 'dul ba'i thabs la mkhas pas dmigs rnaM du mar gsungs pa yin no zhes zer ro |

yan chad do zhes sbyar nas | brgyad stong bar ni gzhan thogs med kyi lugs bshad pa yin pas mi 'gal lo zhes zer ro || de ni ma yin te |

'di la khyung po na re | rnaM thar sgoM gsuM shes ba ni gnyen po cig yin la | 'dis spang bya gsuM spong ngo || °°° shes la sogs pa spong ba ni gnyen po gsuM yin la de gsuM gyis spang bya cig spong zhing | lhag ma rnaMs gnyen po re res spang bya re re spong zhes zer ro ||
de ltar ni ma yin gyi | dags po"dags po" could also be Dwags po lha rje (ID:4189), but the latter is mentioned in the same text as "lha rje". dang 'buM pa na re gnyen po re res
spang bya re re rim pa bzin spong ba yin pas °°°i°o°i° ni phung po lnga la ngo bor gyur pa'aM byin gyis rlob pa po'i bdag med pa yin pas | de shes pas bdag du 'dzin pa spong ste | de gnyis rnaM pa 'gal pa yin pa'i phyir ro ||

gnyis pa ni de la zhes bya ba la sogs pa ste | mda' na re mkhyen pa gong ma gnyis kyi rnaM pa yang rnaM pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i rnaM bar bsdus nas sgoM pa yin pas de'i rnaM pa sgoM pa rgyas par ston no zhes zer ro ||

jo bo ni de gnyis gzung ba dang 'dzin pa bkag pa yin zhes gsung ste | rnal 'byor ba'i blos dmigs par bya ba ni gzung ba lta bu yin la |
rnal 'byor bas goMs par byed pa ni 'dzin pa lta bu yin pas | dang po ltos pa gcod par byed pa'i rigs pas shes bya dang shes pa thams cad ma grub par gtan la phab nas | de ltar goMs par byed pa'i dus su shes bya ma grub par sgoM pa ni gnas pa bkag pa yin la | shes pa ma grub par sgoM pa ni rnal 'byor bkag pa yin no ||

des na 'di kun rnaM par 'khor zhes lugs las 'byung pa lta bu'o || khyung pos sbyor ba 'di thams cad sa brgyad par bshad pa dang | lo tsha bas ldog pa tsaM gyis tha dad par bshad pa ni gzhung dang mi mthun pas mi legs so ||

khyung po na re seng ge bzang pos nges 'byed zag med chung ngur bshad pa'i rjes su
'brangs nas | de'i rigs thar pa'i cha 'thun yang zag med du yar sman nas 'chad do || de ni mi rigs te |
'broM na re thar pa'i cha 'thun zag bcas yin pas de'i rjes su 'brangs nas nges 'byed kyang zag bcas su bshad pa yang seng ge bzang po'i 'dod pa ma yin te skyon 'og du ston no ||

'di la jo bo a pya na re seng bzang la lugs gnyis yod pa las | dang po ltar na las dang po pa'i sa nas sa dgu pa'i par du mkhyen pa gsuM bsgoMs nas | sa bcu pa la sbyor ba bzhi sgoM pa yin te | de ni rgyun
ring por 'jug pas so || zlos pa'i skyon spingspang 'di ni bshad pa sde dang bstun pa yin pas | rnaM pa thams cad du khyad par gyi laM zhes pa ni sa bcu pa la bya'o || de ni seng bzang gis rloMs nas bshad pa yin no || gnyis pa ltar na mkhyen pa gsuM thos bsaM gyis yul du byas te rnaM kun mngon rdzogs las dang po pa'i sa rang nas sgoM pa la sogs pa'i rim pa sngar bstan pa de nyid yin no zhes zer ro ||

lugs gnyis pas | dang po ltar na chos mchog man chad du mkhyen pa gsuM bsgoMs nas sa dang po nas dbu ba'i bar du rnaM kun sgoM la sa bcu pa la rtse mo sgoM de'i smad la mthar gyis pa la sogs pa sgoM pa yin no ||

'di la 'broM ni sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pa gsuM gyi ye shes dang rnal 'byor ba bdag nyid kyi shes pa tha mi dad par rloMs nas sgoM pa yin pas de'i bsaM pa dang sbyar nas nges 'byed la zag med chung rung bshad do ||

dngos po med pa'i ngo bo ni bsdus pa'o zhes zer ro ||
